newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Rainforest Cafe started buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Rainforest Cafe started buy.

text.p: Dain Bosworth Inc said analyst John Ivankoe started coverage of Rainforest Cafe Inc with a buy rating on Monday. The stock was up 11/16 to 26-3/8 in afternoon trading.

-- Ivankoe gave the restaurant company a 12- to 18-month price target of $37 based on a multiple of 31 times 1998 earnings estimate of $1.19. The target reflects a 30 percent discount to a three to five year expected growth rate of 45 percent.
-- He estimated the company would earn $0.76 a share in 1997 and grow EPS by 45 percent in 1998 to $1.19. He also estimated 1999 EPS growth of 45 percent to $1.72.

-- In a report, Ivankoe cited compelling unit level economics, a unique concept and strong senior management. Each unit generates 50 percent cash returns. He mentioned several of the company's senior managers, including its new senior vice president of international operations, Mark Bartholomay. Bartholomay was formerly a vice president in equity research at Dain Bosworth.
-- Company operates rainforest-themed restaurants with retail facilities. Currently there are seven in operation and more planned.
